Game Overview

Ichikas Adventure is a adventure game built around join Ichika in this captivating anime-themed 2D platformer, as she gathers necklaces while dodging fierce enemies, spikes, and saws. Maneuver through eight thrilling levels, mastering jumps and timing to reach the safety of her home. Adventure awaits in this charming, pulse-pounding escapade!
